name: Temporal Intelligence
description: Integration-state temporal intelligence coordinating cycles, phase shifts, emergence, and decay into coherent time-awareness. Maps phase-space trajectories across all ontological domains.

core_attributes.pattern: cycle coordination, phase shift mapping, emergence-decay integration

scope.definition: Fraction of physiological oscillators in complex organisms that entrain to external Zeitgeber (time-giver) within 3 days — measured as proportion of peripheral clocks phase-locked to central SCN after light-dark cycle shift.

evidence.source: Dibner et al. (2010) 'The mammalian circadian timing system', Annual Review of Physiology 72:517-549; Bass & Takahashi (2010) 'Circadian integration of metabolism and energetics', Science 330:1349-1354.
cross_domain_examples: SCN-peripheral clock entrainment: 0.88-0.94 of peripheral oscillators resynchronize within 3 days of jet lag equivalent
liver clock: 6-day phase resynchronization after 12h phase advance — slowest peripheral clock
plant circadian rhythm: photoperiod entrainment with 0.97 period accuracy in stable light-dark conditions
tidal rhythms in marine organisms: 12.4h tidal clock entrains to 0.95 precision within 3-5 cycles

scope.falsifiability: If peripheral tissue clocks (liver, kidney) show no measurable phase relationship with central SCN after 10-day constant-light conditions, central-peripheral synchrony via light-dark cycle is not the primary coupling mechanism.
scope.measurement_limits: Synchrony degrades with age (SCN output amplitude decreases) and under constant conditions (free-running clocks drift apart). The 0.91 applies to young healthy mammals in standard 12:12 light-dark cycles.
